biggest_catch: Five separate $101 bonuses sounds easy, but you must complete each activity type inside a single 120-day window — 30 point-of-sale transactions, 9 bill pays, 8 Zelle uses, 3 mobile deposits, and 3 direct deposits totaling $1,500 — and converted accounts are not eligible.
catches: Each $101 bonus is earned separately inside a 120-calendar-day qualifying bonus period after account opening: 3+ direct deposits totaling $1,500 (DD bonus); 9 bill pay transactions to service providers (bill pay bonus); 3 mobile deposits that clear (mobile deposit bonus); 8 Zelle send/receive uses (Zelle bonus); 30 one-time or recurring point-of-sale transactions (POS bonus).
Limit one of each bonus type — the maximum is $505 if you complete all five; completing just one earns $101.
Person-to-person transfers such as Zelle do not count as eligible bill pay transactions, and ATM withdrawals do not count as point-of-sale transactions.
Converted accounts are not eligible for the bonus; account must be open and active when the bonus is credited.
Bonuses are credited on the next business day following the end of the 120-day bonus period. Cash bonus payments may result in interest being reported to the IRS — general bank-bonus tax treatment.
Offer effective 1/18/23 and subject to change at any time without notice — the bank can end it whenever it wants.
Launch Checking has a $0 minimum opening deposit and $0 monthly service charge per the official account comparison (other TBK checking accounts carry fees, so open the right account).

steps: Go to the official TBK Bank Launch Checking page https://www.tbkbank.com/personal/personal-checking/launch-checking/ and confirm the five bonus types and current terms before opening.
Open a new Launch Checking account online (18+, subject to approval) — make sure it is a new account, not a conversion, and note the $0 minimum opening deposit and $0 monthly fee.

Within 120 calendar days of the account open date, complete any of the five qualifying activity sets: at least 3 direct deposits totaling $1,500+; 9 bill pay transactions to service providers; 3 mobile deposits that clear; 8 Zelle send/receive uses; or 30 point-of-sale transactions.
Each completed activity set earns $101 (limit one of each; up to $505 total). Note that Zelle transfers do not count as bill pay and ATM withdrawals do not count as POS transactions.
Keep the account open and active — each qualifying bonus is credited on the next business day after the 120-day bonus period ends.
timing: Any qualifying bonus will be credited to the Launch Checking account on the next business day following the end of the 120-day bonus period, if the account is open and active.
